# Checkout Submit Button

Matches `submit-button-section.tsx` pay CTA styling and states.

## Preview

<CheckoutSubmitButtonDemo />

## Installation

<Installation name="checkout-submit-button" />

## Usage

```tsx
import { CheckoutSubmitButton } from '@/components/lomi-ui/checkout-submit-button';

<CheckoutSubmitButton
  payButtonBgColor="#121317"
  paymentStatus="idle"
  onClick={handlePay}
/>;
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| `label` | `string` | Pay label. Defaults to `Pay`. |
| `subscribeLabel` | `string` | Subscription label. Defaults to `Subscribe`. |
| `isSubscription` | `boolean` | Switches to the subscribe label. |
| `payButtonBgColor` | `string` | Button background. Defaults to `#121317`. |
| `paymentStatus` | `'idle' \| 'processing' \| 'success' \| 'error'` | Visual state. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables the button. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit'` | Native button type. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | Click handler. |
